components.name: Primary button
components.description: Cobalt action with a deeper hover and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#ccd1dd);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;background:var(--action,#305dd9);border-color:var(--action,#305dd9);color:#fff;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;} .ds-primary:hover {background:#244cb9;border-color:#244cb9;color:#fff;} .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6586e9); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled {opacity:.55;cursor:wait;} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary {font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#ccd1dd);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#20232d);} .ds-secondary:hover {background:#f4f6fb;border-color:#abb6d1;} .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6586e9); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;}}

components.css: .ds-nav{background:#181c27;padding:18px;width:188px;} .ds-nav-item{font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;width:100%;background:transparent;color:#aeb7ca;font-size:13px;font-weight:450;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;} .ds-nav-item:hover{background:#242b3a;color:#f5f7ff;} .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"]{background:#2e3c64;color:#f2f5ff;} .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6586e9); outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav-item{flex-direction:column;gap:7px;min-height:52px;padding:9px 6px;}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-item{transition:none;}}

components.name: Selected session row
components.description: Readable preview with muted metadata and an inset selection boundary.
components.css: .ds-session{font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e5e7ef);border-radius:0;padding:20px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#20232d);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease;} .ds-session:hover{background:#f4f6fb;border-color:#abb6d1;} .ds-session[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--wash,#f0f4ff);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #b8caf8;} .ds-session strong{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:650;overflow-wrap:anywhere;} .ds-preview{margin:9px 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;} .ds-meta{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted,#666c7d);} .ds-session:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus,#6586e9); outline-offset:3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-session{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
This is a source-derived record of the implemented proposal, not a user-approved brand system. The user rejected the earlier green palette and typography. The replacement graphite, cool-white, cobalt and Geist direction was selected by the agent; approval remains pending. Tokens describe this build and should preserve its consistency while it is evaluated.

The workspace gives people, device facts and recorded conversation content a quiet reading surface. A dark navigation ground frames white work areas; restrained blue actions and selected states guide movement. Structured rows, thin rules and readable conversation text carry the hierarchy. The north-star wording is descriptive and comes from the direction contract, not a newly confirmed metaphor.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite navigation with cool-white content surfaces.
Self-hosted Geist throughout headings, controls and conversation prose.
Row-based records and thin separators, with flat surfaces at rest.
Cobalt actions and soft blue selection states.
Responsive navigation and explicit labels for identity, devices and account facts.

rules.name: Action and Evidence
rules.body: Use cobalt for actions and selection; keep long evidence content in ink on a light surface.

rules.name: Reading Width
rules.body: Preserve message whitespace, wrap long content and keep the primary conversation measure at 70ch.

rules.name: Flat Surface
rules.body: Use tone and rules to separate work areas; preserve the selected row's inset boundary as a selection cue.

dos: **Do** use the implemented graphite, cool-white and cobalt palette consistently while the proposal is under evaluation.
**Do** preserve visible focus, accessible text labels and responsive field sizing.
**Do** keep long evidence readable, with wrapping and preserved whitespace.
**Do** distinguish factual metadata, action affordances and selected states through their established treatments.
**Do** use thin rules and tonal surfaces to group content.
donts: **Don't** present this agent-selected replacement as user-approved.
**Don't** reintroduce the rejected green brand palette and typography.
**Don't** promote decorative eyebrow headings, colored card edges or hard offset shadows into this system.
**Don't** inherit breakpoint omissions or background-width mismatches as design conventions.
**Don't** let supporting imagery compete with the primary evidence-reading surface.
